description: This file is a unit test class for the ScssHelper service in the CorporateBranding plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It tests various color manipulation methods such as darken, lighten, rgba conversion, and color validation.

classes.name: ScssHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ScssHelper class methods related to color adjustments and validation.

methods.name: testDarken
methods.description: Tests the darken method of ScssHelper with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testLighten
methods.description: Tests the lighten method of ScssHelper with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testRgba
methods.description: Tests the rgba method to convert hex colors to rgba strings with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: testIsColor
methods.description: Tests the color validation method to determine if a string is a valid color representation.
